title: Remote Multicomponent Rehabilitation in Intensive Care Unit Survivors: A Randomized Clinical Trial.
why_selected: This randomized controlled trial is selected because it provides high-level evidence on the effects of remote multicomponent rehabilitation among critical care survivors, which is an important area of research.
discussion_prompts: What are the implications of this study for the implementation of remote rehabilitation programs in ICUs?
How does this study contribute to our understanding of the long-term outcomes of critical illness survivors?
What are the potential limitations of this study, and how might they impact the generalizability of the findings?
